name: Kanji Cats
detailed_description:
Tired of Anki or Duolingo? Embark on a Tasty Journey to Master Japanese Kanji!

Kanji Cats is a beginner-to-advanced kanji learning game that blends the charm of cats, Japanese conveyor belt sushi, and gachapon culture into a fast-paced, interactive learning experience. With pixel-style visuals and bite-sized mini-games, it's the perfect way to kickstart your Japanese journey or sharpen your kanji skills in a vibrant, playful world.

🍣 Key Features

🍥 Sushi-Inspired Mini-Games

Conveyor Sushi

Type the correct furigana for kanji or vocab as sushi glide past you on a conveyor belt.

Cat customer Orders

Listen to audio orders from cat customers and select the correct kanji from lookalike options.

Sushi Box Sorting

Drag and drop the correct radicals onto the sushi mat to assemble full kanji characters.

🏅 Vocabulary Levels from N5 to N3

Choose your learning level—from complete beginner (JLPT N5) to intermediate (N3). Focus on vocabulary that fits your skill level and gradually progress.

🎮 Customizable Gameplay

Adjust speed and difficulty settings to match your learning pace.

Focus on specific kana sets or vocabulary topics of your choice.

🎧 Interactive Audio Support

Hear native-level pronunciations of vocabulary words. Strengthen your memory by connecting sounds to visuals and kanji readings.

Kanji Cats is designed for PC and perfect for learners of all ages. Whether you're just starting or looking to brush up before your next JLPT, get ready to learn Japanese the fun way—with sushi, cats, and kanji!

short_description: Tired of Anki or Duolingo? Always get confused by look alike Kanjis? Kanji Cats is a edutainment game that teaches Japanese kanji through sushi-themed mini-games. Practice Japanese by matching, typing, and sorting sushi. Customize JLPT levels (N5-N3), and enjoy a pixel-art sushi bar!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-750 / AMD Phenom II X4 965
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Hardware Accelerated Graphics with Dedicated Memory
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU supporting OpenGL 3.3 or Metal, with at least 512MB VRAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
